name: io.github.questlaw/questlaw-library
description: Read-only MCP server for your QuestLaw library. Decrypts locally and makes no network connections.

environmentVariables.name: QUESTLAW_VAULT_FILE
environmentVariables.description: A .qlvault export, or a folder to take the newest one from. Defaults to ~/Downloads.

environmentVariables.name: QUESTLAW_DISCLOSURE_ACK
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'i-understand' to confirm you accept that this connector shares your decrypted library, including captured opinion text, with your AI client and its provider. Without it the server serves nothing.

environmentVariables.name: QUESTLAW_KEY_ACCOUNT
environmentVariables.description: Which account in the OS secret store holds the QuestLaw account key. Defaults to 'default'. Run `questlaw-library-mcp setup` to store one.
